name: Carousel
description: A horizontal gallery of slides on a scroll-snap track — swipeable and keyboard-scrollable with no JavaScript — with arrows, dots and optional auto-advance layered on top.
whenToUse: Designs that show a ROW of slides one or a few at a time, scrolled sideways. Two shapes, and they are different answers rather than a detail to infer: `controls='arrows'` (or `'both'`) for a gallery the reader drives; `autoAdvanceMs` for one that advances on a timer — and that number comes from the design's own prototype timing, never from a guess. Pass the slides as children to keep the design's own markup; `items` is a data fallback for previews. NOT for a row of cards that all fit at once (that is a grid), not for cards stacked on top of each other and driven by scroll (that is ScrollStack), and not for a sequence the reader has to complete in order (that is StepFlow).

implements.note: The track scrolls and snaps with no JavaScript; the arrows and dots are what need it.

Set autoAdvanceMs from the design's own AFTER_TIMEOUT delay. Never invent an interval — omitting it is correct when the design does not specify one. Auto-advance stops under prefers-reduced-motion and always ships a pause control.
